units.rawText: Bonneville turns around somewhat, falling into her thoughts as she looks at the Professor behind her.
units.displayText: Bonneville turns around somewhat, falling into her thoughts as she looks at the Professor behind her.

spans.text: Bonneville turns around somewhat, falling into her thoughts as she looks at the Professor behind her.

units.rawText: Even now, she could not find a reason why the Professor put this challenge forward.
units.displayText: Even now, she could not find a reason why the Professor put this challenge forward.

spans.text: Even now, she could not find a reason why the Professor put this challenge forward.

units.rawText: She had thought that the Professor would employ some stratagem or trick in the race, and made preparations to counteract whatever she might be met with.
units.displayText: She had thought that the Professor would employ some stratagem or trick in the race, and made preparations to counteract whatever she might be met with.

spans.text: She had thought that the Professor would employ some stratagem or trick in the race, and made preparations to counteract whatever she might be met with.

units.rawText: But the Professor did nothing. Ever since the race began, they've only done one thing: trying to put those barely practiced techniques into practice to shorten the gap.
units.displayText: But the Professor did nothing. Ever since the race began, they've only done one thing: trying to put those barely practiced techniques into practice to shorten the gap.

spans.text: But the Professor did nothing. Ever since the race began, they've only done one thing: trying to put those barely practiced techniques into practice to shorten the gap.

units.rawText: Nothing more, nothing less.
units.displayText: Nothing more, nothing less.

spans.text: Nothing more, nothing less.

units.rawText: This abnormality made Bonneville uncomfortable. To get to the bottom of things, she let off the gas for a little, pausing at a small distance just in front of the Professor.
units.displayText: This abnormality made Bonneville uncomfortable. To get to the bottom of things, she let off the gas for a little, pausing at a small distance just in front of the Professor.

spans.text: This abnormality made Bonneville uncomfortable. To get to the bottom of things, she let off the gas for a little, pausing at a small distance just in front of the Professor.

units.rawText: ...Professor, can I ask you a question?
units.displayText: ...Professor, can I ask you a question?

spans.text: ...Professor, can I ask you a question?

units.rawText: It might be weird coming from me... but you should forfeit while you can, Professor.
units.displayText: It might be weird coming from me... but you should forfeit while you can, Professor.

spans.text: It might be weird coming from me... but you should forfeit while you can, Professor.

units.rawText: Before I left being a competing Doll behind, many human drivers challenged me.
units.displayText: Before I left being a competing Doll behind, many human drivers challenged me.

spans.text: Before I left being a competing Doll behind, many human drivers challenged me.

units.rawText: The results were never in question. Even the finest human driver couldn't do anything other than lose by entire laps.
units.displayText: The results were never in question. Even the finest human driver couldn't do anything other than lose by entire laps.

spans.text: The results were never in question. Even the finest human driver couldn't do anything other than lose by entire laps.

units.rawText: In other words, Professor, you have no chance of winning.
units.displayText: In other words, Professor, you have no chance of winning.

spans.text: In other words, Professor, you have no chance of winning.

units.rawText: Yeah, I know. No matter what I do to accelerate and struggle, if you get serious, I have no hope of winning this race.
units.displayText: Yeah, I know. No matter what I do to accelerate and struggle, if you get serious, I have no hope of winning this race.

spans.text: Yeah, I know. No matter what I do to accelerate and struggle, if you get serious, I have no hope of winning this race.

units.rawText: ...Yeah, that's reality.
units.displayText: ...Yeah, that's reality.

spans.text: ...Yeah, that's reality.

units.rawText: I don't know what scheme or method you have ready, but with such a sheer difference in ability, none of that will matter.
units.displayText: I don't know what scheme or method you have ready, but with such a sheer difference in ability, none of that will matter.

spans.text: I don't know what scheme or method you have ready, but with such a sheer difference in ability, none of that will matter.

units.rawText: So... you should give up while it's still early on. Don't waste time on meaningless things.
units.displayText: So... you should give up while it's still early on. Don't waste time on meaningless things.

spans.text: So... you should give up while it's still early on. Don't waste time on meaningless things.

units.rawText: The red knight flips up her faceplate as she looks towards the Professor, trying to convince them to stop this boring farce.
units.displayText: The red knight flips up her faceplate as she looks towards the Professor, trying to convince them to stop this boring farce.

spans.text: The red knight flips up her faceplate as she looks towards the Professor, trying to convince them to stop this boring farce.

units.rawText: The result is not what Bonneville imagined.
units.displayText: The result is not what Bonneville imagined.

spans.text: The result is not what Bonneville imagined.

units.rawText: The Professor does not give up after hearing her words, still holding down the throttle, attempting to overtake her.
units.displayText: The Professor does not give up after hearing her words, still holding down the throttle, attempting to overtake her.

spans.text: The Professor does not give up after hearing her words, still holding down the throttle, attempting to overtake her.

units.rawText: What? You not willing to give up?
units.displayText: What? You not willing to give up?

spans.text: What? You not willing to give up?

units.rawText: Yeah, I still have something important to convey to you.
units.displayText: Yeah, I still have something important to convey to you.

spans.text: Yeah, I still have something important to convey to you.

units.rawText: You've got two things wrong.
units.displayText: You've got two things wrong.

spans.text: You've got two things wrong.

units.rawText: One, I don't have any schemes or plans up my sleeve. I just wanted to race you.
units.displayText: One, I don't have any schemes or plans up my sleeve. I just wanted to race you.

spans.text: One, I don't have any schemes or plans up my sleeve. I just wanted to race you.

units.rawText: Huh? How do you plan to win then? Are you going to yell something about dreams and friendships, then suddenly get an awakening of potential to surpass me?
units.displayText: Huh? How do you plan to win then? Are you going to yell something about dreams and friendships, then suddenly get an awakening of potential to surpass me?

spans.text: Huh? How do you plan to win then? Are you going to yell something about dreams and friendships, then suddenly get an awakening of potential to surpass me?

units.rawText: Those things belong in comic books, not reality.
units.displayText: Those things belong in comic books, not reality.

spans.text: Those things belong in comic books, not reality.

units.rawText: And just like you said, I know all too well the difference between a Doll and a human.
units.displayText: And just like you said, I know all too well the difference between a Doll and a human.

spans.text: And just like you said, I know all too well the difference between a Doll and a human.

units.rawText: ...But even so, I don't want to give up.
units.displayText: ...But even so, I don't want to give up.

spans.text: ...But even so, I don't want to give up.

units.rawText: If not to win, then for...
units.displayText: If not to win, then for...

spans.text: If not to win, then for...

units.rawText: An engine's roar interrupts Bonneville.
units.displayText: An engine's roar interrupts Bonneville.

spans.text: An engine's roar interrupts Bonneville.

units.rawText: Bonneville, there's more to competition than just winning and losing.
units.displayText: Bonneville, there's more to competition than just winning and losing.

spans.text: Bonneville, there's more to competition than just winning and losing.

units.rawText: Even knowing that I would lose, I want to give it everything I have and enjoy it to my fullest, just so I don't have any regrets.
units.displayText: Even knowing that I would lose, I want to give it everything I have and enjoy it to my fullest, just so I don't have any regrets.

spans.text: Even knowing that I would lose, I want to give it everything I have and enjoy it to my fullest, just so I don't have any regrets.

units.rawText: The familiar words pry away at Bonneville's locked-away inner heart.
units.displayText: The familiar words pry away at Bonneville's locked-away inner heart.

spans.text: The familiar words pry away at Bonneville's locked-away inner heart.

units.rawText: She turns around, seeing the silhouette of an old friend projected on the Professor, still chasing after her.
units.displayText: She turns around, seeing the silhouette of an old friend projected on the Professor, still chasing after her.

spans.text: She turns around, seeing the silhouette of an old friend projected on the Professor, still chasing after her.

units.rawText: Thurbel...
units.displayText: Thurbel...

spans.text: Thurbel...

units.rawText: While the Doll is lost in thought, the Professor accelerates, arriving at Bonneville's side, yelling out their ideals at her.
units.displayText: While the Doll is lost in thought, the Professor accelerates, arriving at Bonneville's side, yelling out their ideals at her.

spans.text: While the Doll is lost in thought, the Professor accelerates, arriving at Bonneville's side, yelling out their ideals at her.

units.rawText: ...One more thing you're wrong about! I don't think this race is anything meaningless!
units.displayText: ...One more thing you're wrong about! I don't think this race is anything meaningless!

spans.text: ...One more thing you're wrong about! I don't think this race is anything meaningless!

units.rawText: Win or lose, that isn't important to me.
units.displayText: Win or lose, that isn't important to me.

spans.text: Win or lose, that isn't important to me.

units.rawText: The meaning that I seek is in the moment, to be with you on the track!
units.displayText: The meaning that I seek is in the moment, to be with you on the track!

spans.text: The meaning that I seek is in the moment, to be with you on the track!

units.rawText: What about you, Bonneville? What is it that you seek when you race?
units.displayText: What about you, Bonneville? What is it that you seek when you race?

spans.text: What about you, Bonneville? What is it that you seek when you race?

units.rawText: The Doll sinks into silence, not knowing how to answer.
units.displayText: The Doll sinks into silence, not knowing how to answer.

spans.text: The Doll sinks into silence, not knowing how to answer.

units.rawText: ...I don't know, Professor.
units.displayText: ...I don't know, Professor.

spans.text: ...I don't know, Professor.

units.rawText: I gave up racing because I didn't know the answer to that.
units.displayText: I gave up racing because I didn't know the answer to that.

spans.text: I gave up racing because I didn't know the answer to that.

units.rawText: To the old me, racing itself was happiness.
units.displayText: To the old me, racing itself was happiness.

spans.text: To the old me, racing itself was happiness.

units.rawText: I could keep accelerating and accelerating, using my capabilities as a Doll to the extreme.
units.displayText: I could keep accelerating and accelerating, using my capabilities as a Doll to the extreme.

spans.text: I could keep accelerating and accelerating, using my capabilities as a Doll to the extreme.

units.rawText: Honestly, I really enjoyed the feeling of contending with the other competitors.
units.displayText: Honestly, I really enjoyed the feeling of contending with the other competitors.

spans.text: Honestly, I really enjoyed the feeling of contending with the other competitors.

units.rawText: Bonneville's nostalgia can be seen in her eyes. Passion burns within for but a moment, but its flame is soon extinguished by a great gale.
units.displayText: Bonneville's nostalgia can be seen in her eyes. Passion burns within for but a moment, but its flame is soon extinguished by a great gale.

spans.text: Bonneville's nostalgia can be seen in her eyes. Passion burns within for but a moment, but its flame is soon extinguished by a great gale.

units.rawText: ...But everything changed after that.
units.displayText: ...But everything changed after that.

spans.text: ...But everything changed after that.

units.rawText: I participated in the underground races as I had before, but that sort of happiness was gone. It never came back.
units.displayText: I participated in the underground races as I had before, but that sort of happiness was gone. It never came back.

spans.text: I participated in the underground races as I had before, but that sort of happiness was gone. It never came back.

units.rawText: Money, flowers, fame... any amount of those could never fill the hole in my heart.
units.displayText: Money, flowers, fame... any amount of those could never fill the hole in my heart.

spans.text: Money, flowers, fame... any amount of those could never fill the hole in my heart.

units.rawText: Maybe it's just as Thurbel says. The moment our consciousnesses are put together through those strings, we wave goodbye to freedom, becoming merely puppets strung up by capital in a game of profit.
units.displayText: Maybe it's just as Thurbel says. The moment our consciousnesses are put together through those strings, we wave goodbye to freedom, becoming merely puppets strung up by capital in a game of profit.

spans.text: Maybe it's just as Thurbel says. The moment our consciousnesses are put together through those strings, we wave goodbye to freedom, becoming merely puppets strung up by capital in a game of profit.

units.rawText: That's exactly why I gave up racing—there's no happiness to be found there for me, someone who never tasted any freedom.
units.displayText: That's exactly why I gave up racing—there's no happiness to be found there for me, someone who never tasted any freedom.

spans.text: That's exactly why I gave up racing—there's no happiness to be found there for me, someone who never tasted any freedom.

units.rawText: So come on, Professor, refute me. Refute this useless Doll who's abandoned their duty.
units.displayText: So come on, Professor, refute me. Refute this useless Doll who's abandoned their duty.

spans.text: So come on, Professor, refute me. Refute this useless Doll who's abandoned their duty.

units.rawText: The smile the red knight squeezes out is full of self-deprecation and heartache.
units.displayText: The smile the red knight squeezes out is full of self-deprecation and heartache.

spans.text: The smile the red knight squeezes out is full of self-deprecation and heartache.

units.rawText: She waits to be reprimanded. This is the only way to stop past transgressions from being forgotten with time.
units.displayText: She waits to be reprimanded. This is the only way to stop past transgressions from being forgotten with time.

spans.text: She waits to be reprimanded. This is the only way to stop past transgressions from being forgotten with time.

units.rawText: ...No, I won't.
units.displayText: ...No, I won't.

spans.text: ...No, I won't.

units.rawText: Bonneville, you didn't do anything wrong with the Thurbel situation. At the end of the day, there shouldn't be any of these victories that are renounced!
units.displayText: Bonneville, you didn't do anything wrong with the Thurbel situation. At the end of the day, there shouldn't be any of these victories that are renounced!

spans.text: Bonneville, you didn't do anything wrong with the Thurbel situation. At the end of the day, there shouldn't be any of these victories that are renounced!

units.rawText: What are you saying, Professor...
units.displayText: What are you saying, Professor...

spans.text: What are you saying, Professor...

units.rawText: Who else is to blame! Thurbel died because I turned her down!
units.displayText: Who else is to blame! Thurbel died because I turned her down!

spans.text: Who else is to blame! Thurbel died because I turned her down!

units.rawText: If I just gave up fighting, let go, and let her have first place, everything would have turned out different!
units.displayText: If I just gave up fighting, let go, and let her have first place, everything would have turned out different!

spans.text: If I just gave up fighting, let go, and let her have first place, everything would have turned out different!

units.rawText: Bonneville lets go of the class, slowly decelerating.
units.displayText: Bonneville lets go of the class, slowly decelerating.

spans.text: Bonneville lets go of the class, slowly decelerating.

units.rawText: If only I just... worked out what she really meant with what she said.
units.displayText: If only I just... worked out what she really meant with what she said.

spans.text: If only I just... worked out what she really meant with what she said.

units.rawText: I figured out something was up with her, but I never thought that it would be life or death for her.
units.displayText: I figured out something was up with her, but I never thought that it would be life or death for her.

spans.text: I figured out something was up with her, but I never thought that it would be life or death for her.

units.rawText: If I simply threw the match and let her live on, she could have continued participating and contending with me on the track!
units.displayText: If I simply threw the match and let her live on, she could have continued participating and contending with me on the track!

spans.text: If I simply threw the match and let her live on, she could have continued participating and contending with me on the track!

units.rawText: ...Do you think she would have been willing to accept that?
units.displayText: ...Do you think she would have been willing to accept that?

spans.text: ...Do you think she would have been willing to accept that?

units.rawText: She might have been angry or repulsed, but that was the only she could have kept living!
units.displayText: She might have been angry or repulsed, but that was the only she could have kept living!

spans.text: She might have been angry or repulsed, but that was the only she could have kept living!

units.rawText: Bonneville screams into the wind with anguish. She suddenly accelerates, wanting to speed away from the misgivings of the past.
units.displayText: Bonneville screams into the wind with anguish. She suddenly accelerates, wanting to speed away from the misgivings of the past.

spans.text: Bonneville screams into the wind with anguish. She suddenly accelerates, wanting to speed away from the misgivings of the past.

units.rawText: But no matter how she turns and swivels, the figure behind her stays close to her, just like the friend she once had on the track.
units.displayText: But no matter how she turns and swivels, the figure behind her stays close to her, just like the friend she once had on the track.

spans.text: But no matter how she turns and swivels, the figure behind her stays close to her, just like the friend she once had on the track.

units.rawText: Oi! You wanna die, Professor?
units.displayText: Oi! You wanna die, Professor?

spans.text: Oi! You wanna die, Professor?

units.rawText: For a newbie like you this speed is way too dangerous!
units.displayText: For a newbie like you this speed is way too dangerous!

spans.text: For a newbie like you this speed is way too dangerous!

units.rawText: ...None of that matters! Before I can make you remember your original reasons, I'm not backing down!
units.displayText: ...None of that matters! Before I can make you remember your original reasons, I'm not backing down!

spans.text: ...None of that matters! Before I can make you remember your original reasons, I'm not backing down!

units.rawText: Their motorcycle rumbles and presses forward again, approaching the red figure ahead.
units.displayText: Their motorcycle rumbles and presses forward again, approaching the red figure ahead.

spans.text: Their motorcycle rumbles and presses forward again, approaching the red figure ahead.

units.rawText: ...Don't blemish Thurbel's resolve by handing over a hollow victory like that.
units.displayText: ...Don't blemish Thurbel's resolve by handing over a hollow victory like that.

spans.text: ...Don't blemish Thurbel's resolve by handing over a hollow victory like that.

units.rawText: In that last match you gave it everything you had and beat her fair and square. That's what she craves as a racer.
units.displayText: In that last match you gave it everything you had and beat her fair and square. That's what she craves as a racer.

spans.text: In that last match you gave it everything you had and beat her fair and square. That's what she craves as a racer.

units.rawText: What about you then, Bonneville?
units.displayText: What about you then, Bonneville?

spans.text: What about you then, Bonneville?

units.rawText: Casting aside those constraints forced upon you by competition, for what do you compete on the track, time and time again?
units.displayText: Casting aside those constraints forced upon you by competition, for what do you compete on the track, time and time again?

spans.text: Casting aside those constraints forced upon you by competition, for what do you compete on the track, time and time again?

units.rawText: Bonneville falls into a stupor as she stares at the Professor next to her. The howling winds and trilling engines suddenly fade away, and only silence is left in this world within her mind.
units.displayText: Bonneville falls into a stupor as she stares at the Professor next to her. The howling winds and trilling engines suddenly fade away, and only silence is left in this world within her mind.

spans.text: Bonneville falls into a stupor as she stares at the Professor next to her. The howling winds and trilling engines suddenly fade away, and only silence is left in this world within her mind.

units.rawText: My original reasons?
units.displayText: My original reasons?

spans.text: My original reasons?

units.rawText: Bonneville never really forgot what she raced for.
units.displayText: Bonneville never really forgot what she raced for.

spans.text: Bonneville never really forgot what she raced for.

units.rawText: As a racing Doll, pursuing the extremes of speed had always been in her bones. It was why she drove and journeyed.
units.displayText: As a racing Doll, pursuing the extremes of speed had always been in her bones. It was why she drove and journeyed.

spans.text: As a racing Doll, pursuing the extremes of speed had always been in her bones. It was why she drove and journeyed.

units.rawText: But to say that out loud would be to validate the her that killed Thurbel for the sake of such sentiment.
units.displayText: But to say that out loud would be to validate the her that killed Thurbel for the sake of such sentiment.

spans.text: But to say that out loud would be to validate the her that killed Thurbel for the sake of such sentiment.

units.rawText: So I...
units.displayText: So I...

spans.text: So I...

units.rawText: The growling of a motorcycle tears apart the silence in the moment. Bonneville recognized its sound. The same sound that chased after her day and night back then.
units.displayText: The growling of a motorcycle tears apart the silence in the moment. Bonneville recognized its sound. The same sound that chased after her day and night back then.

spans.text: The growling of a motorcycle tears apart the silence in the moment. Bonneville recognized its sound. The same sound that chased after her day and night back then.

units.rawText: Thurbel...
units.displayText: Thurbel...

spans.text: Thurbel...

units.rawText: That expression doesn't suit our four-time champion...
units.displayText: That expression doesn't suit our four-time champion...

spans.text: That expression doesn't suit our four-time champion...

units.rawText: Seriously, where did our free-spirited meteor who only lives for speed go?
units.displayText: Seriously, where did our free-spirited meteor who only lives for speed go?

spans.text: Seriously, where did our free-spirited meteor who only lives for speed go?

units.rawText: Bonneville had a million words to gush out to the phantom before her, but they all wilt into apologies when they reach her lips.
units.displayText: Bonneville had a million words to gush out to the phantom before her, but they all wilt into apologies when they reach her lips.

spans.text: Bonneville had a million words to gush out to the phantom before her, but they all wilt into apologies when they reach her lips.

units.rawText: ...I'm sorry.
units.displayText: ...I'm sorry.

spans.text: ...I'm sorry.

units.rawText: Hey, why are you apologizing? In competition, a winner's apology is a slight upon the loser.
units.displayText: Hey, why are you apologizing? In competition, a winner's apology is a slight upon the loser.

spans.text: Hey, why are you apologizing? In competition, a winner's apology is a slight upon the loser.

units.rawText: Don't overthink the business with me so much. You're dumb as a pile of bricks, whenever you fall out of your comfort zone you make every problem more complicated than it has to be.
units.displayText: Don't overthink the business with me so much. You're dumb as a pile of bricks, whenever you fall out of your comfort zone you make every problem more complicated than it has to be.

spans.text: Don't overthink the business with me so much. You're dumb as a pile of bricks, whenever you fall out of your comfort zone you make every problem more complicated than it has to be.

units.rawText: Right, is that human chasing after you the Professor?
units.displayText: Right, is that human chasing after you the Professor?

spans.text: Right, is that human chasing after you the Professor?

units.rawText: Ah? Yeah... why ask this all of a sudden?
units.displayText: Ah? Yeah... why ask this all of a sudden?

spans.text: Ah? Yeah... why ask this all of a sudden?

units.rawText: Just really wanted to know. I haven't seen you smile while on the back of a motorcycle in a good while, you know.
units.displayText: Just really wanted to know. I haven't seen you smile while on the back of a motorcycle in a good while, you know.

spans.text: Just really wanted to know. I haven't seen you smile while on the back of a motorcycle in a good while, you know.

units.rawText: Smi... le?
units.displayText: Smi... le?

spans.text: Smi... le?

units.rawText: She looks at the reflection of herself in the rearview mirror. Just as Thurbel said, she finds herself smiling from her heart, enjoying this race against the Professor.
units.displayText: She looks at the reflection of herself in the rearview mirror. Just as Thurbel said, she finds herself smiling from her heart, enjoying this race against the Professor.

spans.text: She looks at the reflection of herself in the rearview mirror. Just as Thurbel said, she finds herself smiling from her heart, enjoying this race against the Professor.

units.rawText: Looks like you've found someone who can run alongside you~ good, very good.
units.displayText: Looks like you've found someone who can run alongside you~ good, very good.

spans.text: Looks like you've found someone who can run alongside you~ good, very good.

units.rawText: She pats Bonneville on the back, moving apace with her.
units.displayText: She pats Bonneville on the back, moving apace with her.

spans.text: She pats Bonneville on the back, moving apace with her.

units.rawText: Keep going, champ! You're the only one among us to be free of your strings!
units.displayText: Keep going, champ! You're the only one among us to be free of your strings!

spans.text: Keep going, champ! You're the only one among us to be free of your strings!

units.rawText: A friend of old smiles as they pass on blessings and inspiration to those who still live, slowly fading away.
units.displayText: A friend of old smiles as they pass on blessings and inspiration to those who still live, slowly fading away.

spans.text: A friend of old smiles as they pass on blessings and inspiration to those who still live, slowly fading away.

units.rawText: ...Hmph, you've still got that annoying habit of forcing things on people.
units.displayText: ...Hmph, you've still got that annoying habit of forcing things on people.

spans.text: ...Hmph, you've still got that annoying habit of forcing things on people.

units.rawText: But I wouldn't have it any other way!
units.displayText: But I wouldn't have it any other way!

spans.text: But I wouldn't have it any other way!

units.rawText: She turns towards the Professor, her mount's outcry a declaration of war.
units.displayText: She turns towards the Professor, her mount's outcry a declaration of war.

spans.text: She turns towards the Professor, her mount's outcry a declaration of war.

units.rawText: Professor, I'm about to speed up! You think you're ready to try and keep up?
units.displayText: Professor, I'm about to speed up! You think you're ready to try and keep up?

spans.text: Professor, I'm about to speed up! You think you're ready to try and keep up?

units.rawText: Yeah, any time!
units.displayText: Yeah, any time!

spans.text: Yeah, any time!
